environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT review #9 FB-9-01..05 including application-level reliable events (protocol v2) and soak gate v5 (realized impairment).
hypothesis: Authenticated-only liveness, handle-based key loading, rate-limited unauthenticated handshakes, and application-acked events with host resend/replay work on both backends, plaintext and secure; gate v5 detects silently disabled impairment.
procedure: Implemented FB-9-01/04/05, protocol v2 events (D-017) with host/client API, executables (--event-interval-ms) and soak gate v5 (fixed before its runs). Regression tests with mutation checks where applicable. Quick 30 s v5 soaks to validate the gates, diagnostics for the secure reconnect tail, then the full battery: 12 x 120 s v5 soaks (plaintext and secure, both backends), all suites x2, E2E, asymmetric x4, secure E2E x2, KI-27 stress.
expected_result: All tests pass; all soaks pass gate v5.
observed_result: Defects found and fixed: (1) the first ClientHello rate limit let forgeries from a player address starve its reconnect (8 s; found by the FB-8-01 test) -> known players exempt; (2) head-of-line blocking: frequent reliable EventAcks delayed the final reliable Disconnect past the close drain (quick moderate-gns-sec: an extra timeout) -> EventAck unreliable, Disconnect also unreliable; (3) an event that overtook the ConnectAccept was discarded and never resent on reliable transports, so one client got 0 events for a whole run -> host resends on every transport. Mutation checks: FB-9-01 old behaviour fails its regression. Symlink refusal NOT RUN (error 1314, no privilege). KI-35: secure harsh stall recovery tail; quick UDP runs 7/12 > 3 s before the 1 s DTLS retransmit cap (max 11.3 s), 3/8 after (max 5.1 s); in-process reproduction 1.2-2.8 s in 8/8; root cause not established.
